claims.text: Ponto was the middle child of Balbo and Berylla Baggins. He married Mimosa Bunce, with whom he had two children: Rosa and Polo.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"

claims.text: Ponto died in , the year when the Shire suffered from the Fell Winter.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age"
